issue.body:
This is a rewrite of the existing remote dev functionality

- pom.xml changes are supported
- Webosckets are no longer required, HTTP is optionally used instead
- The same image can now be used for both dev and production
- Changes are synced on connect, so it is no longer possible to get out of sync
- Maven/Gradle is no longer required in the remote image
- External tools can be used to perform the sync

issue.title: Prefer output dir for hot deployment of resources
issue.body:
The original resources without Maven properties resolution were provided by Static Handler for `src/main/resources/META-INF/resources` files when running in dev mode. The strategy used for hot deployment doesn't consider the resources filtering. So the interpolation of Maven properties wasn't processed.

Resolves #15303

body: @stuartwdouglas @aloubyansky did we have a way of doing filtered resources part of devmode ? maybe not per default but somehow be able to enable it for projects dependent on it ?
That would be a feature request. Property replacement could certainly be supported.

> Property replacement could certainly be supported.

as in calling the underlying build system filtering or by us reimplimenting/emulating it ?

A quick(er) fix would be doing it ourselves. We are not calling the underlying build system for the compilation neither. The approach certainly neglects all the possibly configured extra Maven goals/Gradle tasks but helps make the restart faster.

If I haven't missed something in that additional discussion, the filtering is currently already being performed on devmode. In this issue I've reported that the filtered resources aren't being served by the created `StaticHandler` at `StaticResourcesRecorder`. I've proposed the PR #15312 with changes to allow the classes directory being preferred when serving that static resources. 😅
